categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in intelligent logistics equipment, offering comprehensive solutions in sorting, warehousing, conveying, and handling systems. It also develops core components such as electric rollers and industrial vision systems. Key product lines include intelligent sorting systems (cross-belt, narrow-belt, large-item sorting), intelligent warehousing solutions (stacker cranes, shuttle cars, AGVs), machine vision products, and airport baggage handling systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include industrial IoT high-performance edge computing, autonomous development of sorting equipment (cross-belt, narrow-belt, stacker cranes), AI-based vision detection and barcode recognition algorithms, servo motor integrated drive control, wireless power supply systems, and modular distributed electrical control systems. The company employs advanced manufacturing methods including modular design, automated welding, and in-house production of key components to ensure quality and cost control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major express delivery and logistics enterprises such as ZTO Express, SF Express, JD.com, China Post, and others, as well as e-commerce, new energy, airport, biopharmaceutical, and manufacturing sectors. Its solutions are widely used in express logistics hubs, e-commerce warehouses, airports, and industrial manufacturing facilities, with a growing presence in international markets including Southeast Asia, Europe, and the Americas.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover mainland China extensively, with significant overseas presence through subsidiaries and sales centers in Singapore, Malaysia, the United States, Russia, Thailand, the United Kingdom, Hungary, Germany, Brazil, Mexico, South Korea, and Hong Kong. The company is expanding its global footprint, focusing on Belt and Road countries and major international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, providing integrated intelligent logistics equipment and systems from core component manufacturing to system integration and on-site installation. It also engages in upstream R&D and partial manufacturing of key components to ensure supply chain stability and cost advantages.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically focused on the 'one body, two wings' framework, emphasizing intelligent warehousing logistics equipment as the core, supported by intelligent vision and power technology wings. R&D priorities include AI vision systems, servo drives, wireless power supply, intelligent sorting and warehousing automation, and airport baggage handling. The company invests heavily in innovation, talent acquisition, and expanding its product matrix to meet diverse customer needs and enhance cost efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through sales of customized intelligent logistics equipment and integrated solutions, including sorting systems, warehousing automation, and core components. Additional income streams include technical services, installation, software upgrades, and leasing of equipment. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distributors, with project-based contracts and bidding processes.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic provider of intelligent logistics sorting systems and solutions, ranking among the top tier in China's express logistics equipment market. It competes with both international giants and local peers by leveraging its comprehensive product portfolio, strong R&D capabilities, and integrated system solutions. It holds unique qualifications such as cross-belt and airport ICS system integration, distinguishing it in the industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 2.47 billion, a 26.42% increase year-over-year, despite a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 84.75 million. The company has a total asset base of over RMB 6.19 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.54 billion. It maintains steady revenue growth driven by market expansion and project deliveries, while focusing on cost control and efficiency improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes technology innovation and craftsmanship quality, offering highly automated, efficient, and intelligent logistics solutions tailored to customer needs. Its products feature advanced AI vision detection with over 99% accuracy, modular and flexible designs, and proprietary technologies like wireless power supply and servo-integrated rollers. The integrated software platforms (WMS, WCS, 3DMS) provide real-time visualization and control, enhancing operational efficiency and reducing costs for clients.
